calendar.partial_policy: Shows only pairs whose both legs and FUND existed on that day.
calendar.full_policy: STRICT_FULL requires 8 currencies and 28 pairs with a causal reading.

backtest.entry: FUND leaves NEUTRAL; execution at the next ECB fixing
backtest.exit: FUND loses a band in the direction of the position
backtest.scope_warning: Nao inclui BO, REGIAO, ZOI, SL ATR ou dados intraday.

meta.target: direction of the next daily ECB fixing
meta.signal_timing: information available up to the close of D; target D for the next fixing
meta.selection: the five lowest scores among operational pairs with FUND <= -25 (sell side)
meta.training_scope: PIT_CAUSAL pairs only; AUD/CHF may be displayed, but they neither train nor validate the model
meta.validation: walk-forward anual expansivo; pesos APRENDIDO escolhidos dentro de cada treino
meta.warning: An OBSERVATION is not an entry. Confirm FUND, BO, REGION and ZOI; no direction is guaranteed.
meta.promotion_rule: o limite inferior do IC 95% do melhor modelo deve superar 50%; depois aplicar nulo-do-maximo

meta.target: the pair FUND enters BEAR (<= -25) on the next business day
meta.validation: annual walk-forward; only PIT_CAUSAL pairs train and validate
meta.warning: This is the probability of the FUND entering BEAR — not a guarantee of a fall, nor permission to enter. It exists so the zone can be watched before confirmation.
